messages.subject: gene length when using sourceforge featurecounts?
messages.subject_clean: gene length when using sourceforge featurecounts?
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I had used sourceforge FeatureCounts (v.1.5.0), and got a counts table and counts summary as outputs. However, I'm trying to find the gene lengths that FeatureCounts used. Based on the user manual, my understanding that this info should be stored as part of a few annotation columns that are part of the counts table, but they are missing (or perhaps I misinterpreted, and these columns (‘Geneid’, ‘Chr’, ‘Start’, ‘End’, ‘Strand’ and ‘Length’) are a separate file altogether- in which case, that file is also missing). Is there a way to get this information? Here is the code that I used:

featureCounts -T 8 \
-p -F GTF -t exon -g gene_id -s 2 -C \
--largestOverlap \
-a _Csinensis_154.gtf \
-o wk18_counts.txt \
accepted_hits_C1.bam accepted_hits_C2.bam accepted_hits_C5.bam accepted_hits_C6.bam accepted_hits_H1.bam accepted_hits_H2.bam accepted_hits_H4.bam accepted_hits_H6.bam

The two output files are:
wk18_counts.txt
wk18_counts.txt.summary

Is there something missing in my code to make the gene length show up in the output, or is this indicative of another error?

Thanks,
Liz

messages.subject: featureCounts and counting by Read Group?
messages.subject_clean: featureCounts and counting by Read Group?
messages.body_plain: Hey, is it possible to have an option for featureCounts which counts each alignment in a bam file by read groups? The reason behind this is the following. We have bam files which have several libraries in it. This can come from single cell sequencing, differentiation of UMIs or just a merge of several bam files. Therefore, this option would help a lot. The input would still be the same. You give the program one or multiple bam files. When you active the option, instead of one column per bam file, you get several columns and each column header could be nameOfInputFile_ReadGroup. If a bam file has no read group or a single read group but the option is actived, I'd suggest to only write the the name of the inputfile in the header.
